scope.fixture: synthetic valid 8x8 grayscale SOF0 baseline JPEG with repeated DQT/DHT definitions inserted before SOS; no clipboard, window, helper, package, or physical input
assertions: A cumulative total of 64 quantization-table definitions, including the base table, decodes to the expected opaque gray pixels; 65 definitions fail with image_worker_capacity_exceeded.
A cumulative total of 64 Huffman-table definitions, including the base fixture's DC and AC tables, decodes to the expected opaque gray pixels; 65 definitions fail with image_worker_capacity_exceeded.
scope.construction: Extra DQT definitions repeat table ID 0 with the same 64 one-valued coefficients. Each extra DHT segment defines one DC table ID 0 with one length-1 code; the base fixture contributes two definitions.

limitations: This regression checks the cumulative DQT/DHT definition-count thresholds for one small synthetic JPEG; it does not establish every JPEG metadata limit or broad image compatibility.
The result does not establish a hard memory bound, packaged behavior, product deadline, or complete T04 acceptance.
